name: Via Aurelia, St Maximin - Aix
description_md:
The Via Aurelia from St Maximin to Aix is a waymarked hiking route in France covering 47.3 km. It involves 884 m of ascent and 975 m of descent, requiring about 14 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

This hard route is part of the international waymarked hiking network and follows a line that matches the official route published by ign_bdtopo. Walkers will find that the path passes within 300 m of Aix-en-Provence and the Aix-en-Provence town hall. Additionally, the route comes within 400 m of Saint Saviour's Cathedral.
